thread:
Helena Zhou: FYI nightly-scan failed on main -> SAST flagged auth/token_sanitizer.go (high) and DAST couldn't pull fixtures because KMS decrypt returned 403. I see a policy-gen rollout earlier. @Omar @Riley can you triage?
Omar Singh: scan run: https://ci.example.com/runs/112233 - security-bot summary below
security-bot: nightly-scan 4525123456: result=FAIL, sast=1 high (auth/token_sanitizer.go), dast=1 medium (fixture fetch), infra=KMS_DECRYPT=403 principal=fixture-fetcher@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
Riley Park: artifact error: "rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = Request had insufficient permission to access cryptoKeys/test-fixtures-key, principal=fixture-fetcher@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
policy-bot: policy-gen 4525100000: auto-deploy generator v2.2.4 applied by infra-automation@redwood-tools; change CH-2702. Note: schema prune flag enabled.
Helena Zhou: that prune flag may have removed per-key bindings. Ops, can we get a short-term unblock? Prefer key-level conditional grant with TTL, annotated to CH-2702.
ops-oncall: proposed (dry-run): `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding test-fixtures-key --keyring=testing --location=global --member='serviceAccount:fixture-fetcher@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com' --role='roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter' --condition="expression=request.time < timestamp('2026-04-25T08:00:00Z'),title=short_unblock,description=temporary unblock for nightly CI" --project=redwood-prod` Will apply after audit evidence attached.
Omar Singh: running auditlog: `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName="SetIamPolicy" AND protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail="infra-automation@redwood-tools"' --limit 50`
Riley Park: SAST finding: token_sanitizer.go trims inputs incorrectly leading to possible panic on malformed header. I think it's a real finding. I'll open a small PR to add strict validation and unit tests. No suppress.
policy-bot: audit record attached to CH-2702 shows SetIamPolicy at 2026-04-24T23:45Z with a replace operation that omitted several key-level bindings. Filed POLICY-487 to adjust generator migration logic.
Helena Zhou: ops, you have go-ahead once CH-2702 link included in change. Omar, make incident stub if infra confirms accidental removal across >1 key/project. Riley, ETA on PR?
Riley Park: PR up: https://github.com/redwood/auth/pull/441 (adds strict parse + tests). ETA merge 1h. Will add SAST harness rule to detect same pattern.
ops-oncall: applied conditional binding and annotated CH-2702 with the evidence link and a short justification. Re-run queued.
security-bot: re-run 112234: overall=PASS, sast=PASS(after PR), dast=PASS, infra=artifact-fetch=OK
Helena Zhou: Follow-ups: - infra-tools to fix POLICY-487 (disable prune or preserve key-level bindings during migration) - add nightly preflight `gcloud kms keys test-iam-permissions` for critical keys - ops to document conditional binding process (TTL + audit annotation) - create postmortem only if multiple projects impacted. I'll schedule a 30-min sync with infra next Tue. Thanks team :thumbsup:
